review_note: Color convention (pharmacology review 2026-11-16, approved): green = no change; amber 'Adjust / caution' = the label or a cited guideline gives a dose to use, a changed dose, or a caution; red = avoid, contraindicated or not recommended; gray 'No data' = label silent or not studied and no dose is given (specialist input); hide = band not applicable. Tiles state label cut-offs when they fall inside a site band.
